```{=html}
<section class="hero">

      <p class="hero-sub">are getting married</p>

    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="band band-slim band-deep">
  <div class="band-narrow">

    <p class="eyebrow">Save the date</p>

    <p class="date-line">Saturday, June 19, 2027</p>

    <hr class="date-rule">

    <p class="date-place">
      Fontainebleau Inn<br>
      2800 State Route 228 &nbsp;·&nbsp; Alpine, New York
    </p>

  </div>
</section>

<section class="band band-ivory">
  <div class="band-narrow">

    <h2 class="section-title" style="text-align:center">Weekend Itinerary</h2>

    <div class="day-list">

      <div class="day-entry">
        <div class="day-name">Friday</div>
        <div class="day-body">
          <div class="day-meta">June 18 &nbsp;·&nbsp; Welcome Party</div>
          <p>Join us the night before for a casual BBQ dinner at North Point Pavilion at Taughannock Falls State Park.</p>
          <div class="day-where">North Point Pavilion &nbsp;·&nbsp; Trumansburg, New York</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="day-entry">
        <div class="day-name">Saturday</div>
        <div class="day-body">
          <div class="day-meta">June 19 &nbsp;·&nbsp; The Wedding</div>
          <p>We will have a ceremony at the venue, followed by cocktails, dinner, and dancing.</p>
          <div class="day-where">Fontainebleau Inn &nbsp;·&nbsp; Alpine, New York</div>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>

    <div class="weekend-photo">
      <img src="images/maine.jpg"
           alt="Gabrielle and Riley on a hike in Maine, with the harbor and green hills behind them.">
    </div>

  </div>
</section>

<section class="band band-blue">
  <div class="band-narrow">

    <p class="eyebrow-lg">Counting Down</p>

    <div class="countdown" id="countdown">
      <div class="count-unit"><div class="count-num" id="cd-days">&mdash;</div><div class="count-label">Days</div></div>
      <div class="count-unit"><div class="count-num" id="cd-hours">&mdash;</div><div class="count-label">Hours</div></div>
      <div class="count-unit"><div class="count-num" id="cd-mins">&mdash;</div><div class="count-label">Minutes</div></div>
      <div class="count-unit"><div class="count-num" id="cd-secs">&mdash;</div><div class="count-label">Seconds</div></div>
    </div>

  </div>
</section>


<script>
(function () {
  // Ceremony day. Counts down to the morning of the wedding.
  var target = new Date(2027, 5, 19, 0, 0, 0).getTime();

  function pad(n) { return n < 10 ? "0" + n : String(n); }

  function tick() {
    var diff = target - Date.now();

    if (diff <= 0) {
      var el = document.getElementById("countdown");
      if (el) {
        el.innerHTML =
          '<div class="count-unit" style="min-width:auto">' +
          '<div class="count-num">Today!</div></div>';
      }
      return;
    }

    var s = Math.floor(diff / 1000);
    document.getElementById("cd-days").textContent  = Math.floor(s / 86400);
    document.getElementById("cd-hours").textContent = pad(Math.floor(s / 3600) % 24);
    document.getElementById("cd-mins").textContent  = pad(Math.floor(s / 60) % 60);
    document.getElementById("cd-secs").textContent  = pad(s % 60);

    setTimeout(tick, 1000);
  }

  tick();
})();
</script>
```
